title: Data Pump · Safe transfer. A demanding proving ground.

scenes.title: Safely move data.
scenes.subtitle: Across security boundaries.
sentences: Data Pump was built to safely move data across security boundaries, using hardware computers already have.
Developers from the team turned that practical need into a demanding proving ground for reusable development practices.

scenes.title: Preserve the boundary.
scenes.subtitle: Keep useful work moving.
sentences: Critical development and bootstrapping systems need useful data transfer without a direct network or peripheral-bus infection path.
Data Pump helps complete an isolating workstation. It does not make received files safe to open.

scenes.title: Working software.
scenes.subtitle: Encrypted text and files.
scenes.note: 30 kB repeated-text example · compressed for transfer
sentences: This is the working application: an encrypted file is transmitted, received, and authenticated.
Ordinary speakers and microphones can carry the data. An audio cable is another convenient option.

scenes.title: From bits to kilobits.
scenes.subtitle: Olivia’s origins: December 2004.
sentences: Olivia dates back more than twenty years; its common text modes run at roughly Morse-code speeds.
The illustrated Olivia mode carries about a hundred bits per second.
Data Pump’s documented speaker-and-microphone trial exceeded twenty-eight thousand bits per second: roughly two hundred and sixty times that rate.

scenes.title: Minimize apparent interference.
scenes.subtitle: Low received power. A private waveform.
sentences: Robust Modem adds fixed-location radio capability as a useful extension.
Its encrypted private waveform combines received energy below the background noise with a noise-like appearance and no public acquisition marker.
The intended receiver knows what to collect.

scenes.title: Plan. Transmit. Recover.
scenes.subtitle: A received bit at 150 dB loss.
scenes.note: 2 mW · 1.5 kHz carrier · keyed waveform · simulation
sentences: Here, the recorded simulation recovers a bit with two milliwatts of transmit power and one hundred and fifty decibels of path loss.
That makes demanding link assumptions concrete and testable.

scenes.title: A demanding proving ground.
scenes.subtitle: Recurring problems, tested together.
sentences: The difficult example was the broader impetus for the project.
Portable interfaces. Regression tests. Continuous data flow and cancellation. Reproducible builds. Verified releases. And parallel development that preserves each contribution.

scenes.title: Solve the recurring problems.
scenes.subtitle: Carry the practices forward.
sentences: The value reaches beyond reusable code.
Exercising these problems together exposes the boundaries, failure cases, and development practices that future projects would otherwise have to discover again.

scenes.title: From weeks of lessons
scenes.subtitle: to a faster starting point.
sentences: Software Foundation carries those practices forward, with shared application behavior across seven interfaces.
The ambition: take work of comparable breadth from roughly two weeks to a few hours, potentially just one.

scenes.title: A starting point for much more.
scenes.subtitle: Safe data transfer remains the priority.
sentences: Safe data transfer remains Data Pump’s development priority.
This is one example of the team’s capabilities, and a starting point for applying tested practices to many more ambitious projects.
